title: What business intelligence is and what it is not

videos.script: Every Monday at Varanda, somebody asks how last week went. {{monday}} Until this year the answer arrived after lunch, typed by hand into an email. Twice last year, two directors brought different totals to the same meeting. {{two-totals}} Neither had made a mistake. They had counted a sale in two different ways, and nobody had written either way down. That is the problem business intelligence exists to solve. {{definition}} It is not a program and it is not a dashboard. It is the work of turning the records a company already keeps into answers to the decisions it has to make, the same way every time. This lesson takes that sentence apart. {{not}} Then it names five things BI is often mistaken for, and each one costs money. {{cycle}} Then the loop every piece of BI work goes round, and the two places where it usually breaks. Last, your tools. {{sheet}} This course needs a spreadsheet and nothing else. You set one up, type Varanda's sales for 2025, and see the two mistakes that give a wrong number without an error.
